verdict.rationale: Stripe offers autonomous background automation primitives—webhooks for event-driven triggers, Smart Retries/revenue recovery, automated tax and billing—and an MCP server plus agent skills/SDKs letting AI agents interact with the Stripe API. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated no-code 'agent automation builder'; autonomy is achieved by combining webhooks, billing rules, and MCP tool calls rather than a single agentic automation setup flow.
